phrase.zh: 一次反馈，改变下一次选择。

visual.zh: 分岔道路和回环箭头围绕一个行动者，表现尝试、结果和调整。道路不是某个算法真实的决策轨迹。
visual.en: Forking paths and return arrows surround an agent, suggesting trial, outcome and adjustment. They are not a real algorithm’s decision trace.

background.zh: 强化学习研究行动者如何通过与环境互动、接收反馈来改进选择。2015 年的深度 Q 网络研究展示了从游戏画面和得分学习控制策略；游戏结果不能直接推断现实任务中的能力。
background.en: Reinforcement learning studies how an agent improves choices through interaction and feedback. A 2015 deep Q-network study learned game-control policies from pixels and scores; game performance does not establish real-world ability.

sources.label: Mnih et al. · Deep reinforcement learning
